evidence.name: Screen field: Auto-Advance Duration
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Auto-Advance Duration" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Auto-Advance Duration
sections.description: The number of seconds or minutes (unit chosen below) before the screen moves on by itself, from 1 to 300. Only used when auto-advance is on. Keep it short, about 2 to 4 seconds for a splash or 'analyzing...' screen, so visitors aren't left waiting and bouncing.
